items.title: Peter Schiff argues Bitcoin may fall below $16,500 by year-end if $50,000 breaks next
items.teaser: His Nov. 14 call extends earlier $20,000 warnings while Bitcoin and Ethereum traded above the conditions he identified. Read the full story on CryptoSlate Understand the crypto stories that matter …

items.title: House Oversight Chair calls for possible ban on government officials’ prediction market bets over insider trading concerns
items.teaser: The House Oversight Committee is calling for new limits on government officials’ use of prediction markets, including a potential ban.

items.title: From $6 to $6.9 million: Two dormant Bitcoin addresses wake up to move 100 BTC after more than 16 years
items.teaser: Two Bitcoin whale addresses moved 100 BTC worth $6.89 million after more than 16 years of dormancy on Friday.

items.title: Bitcoin hits 12-week low as dollar rallies on interest-rate outlook, liquidations top $1.6 billion
items.teaser: Bitcoin (BTC) fell below $70,000 for the first time since August and is down 3.5% since midnight UTC, as the dollar climbs and liquidations top $1.6 billion.
